hardest_step: Extend the retained positive disk second-derivative margin to the actual finite spectral form domain, recover full tensor second derivatives with R' independent of AR-R^2, and preserve two outer powers in the complete local mixed row including the off-shell return.
quantitative_consequence: The actual density-correct residual has Schur source N(p)<2e28 ell^2. The full finite mixed vertex obeys ||t^2 V_T y||<2e4 g^-1/2 ||y||. This supplies a strong initial source but does not bound its three graph transfers or its signed moment.

primary_source.title: Uwe Semmelmann and Gregor Weingart, The Standard Laplace Operator
primary_source.location: Equation (7), printed page 12, PDF page index 11
primary_source.established_result: The third covariant derivative commutator supplies the torsion-free Ricci identity used in the integrated tensor estimate.
primary_source.does_not_supply: The charged finite-comparison constants, TT domain extension, source conversion or signed compatibility. No novelty is claimed for the commutator.

comparison: The earlier seed strong-vertex estimate does not apply to a finite comparison by substitution: R'=AR-R^2 is seed-specific. The new argument retains independent warping derivatives and the actual finite form. The direct earlier signed-moment allowance is sharper than the unsigned moment bound obtained here; the new use is strong weighted source regularity before transfer estimates.
